parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the bastion host. 
> You can invoke [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: The name, phone number, or email address of the notification recipient to query. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to query. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The request token. Leave this parameter empty or set it to an empty string for the first request.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description:
The project ID.
> You can call ListProjects to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

parameters.name: Skip
parameters.description:
The number of entries to skip.
> This parameter takes effect only when NextToken is empty.
